verdict.rationale: dlt is fundamentally code-first: pipelines, transformations, schema handling, and even the dltHub Web UI's monitoring functions are accessible via Python API and CLI (dlt-docs-10, dlt-docs-12, dlt-docs-15, dlt-comm-9), and there's also an MCP server for pipeline inspection/debugging (dlt-docs-72, dlt-probe-4). However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose REST/OpenAPI API covering all Web UI (app.dlthub.com) functionality — the openapi probe returned 404s (dlt-probe-3), suggesting UI-only features (e.g., visual monitoring dashboards) may lack full API parity. missing for 10: a documented public OpenAPI/REST API mirroring all dltHub Web UI capabilities, confirmation that every UI action (not just monitoring/inspection) has an API equivalent, independent verification of API-UI parity.
